summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Mid Cap Value ETF (AEMV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital growth through a concentrated portfolio of US mid-cap value companies. The fund employs a proprietary value-factor analysis to select 75 to 150 stocks. AEMV was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AEMV is an equity ETF with a total of 98 individual holdings. The top holdings are Marathon Petroleum stock at 3.80%, Ameriprise Financial at 3.19%, Host Hotels & Resorts at 3.19%, MGIC Investment at 2.91%, and Crown Holdings at 2.86%.
